rules.statement: A person alleging that he is fideicommissarius under a deed is not entitled to file an action for a declaration preventing the fiduciarius or the transferee of the interests from effecting useful improvements on the fideicommissary property.
rules.supporting_quote: "A person, alleging that he is fideicommissarius under a deed, is not entitled to file action for a declaration that the deed created a fideicommissum and to prevent the fiduciarius, or the transferee of the interests of the fiduciarius, from effecting useful improvements on the fideicommissary property."
